edges: Lucile is asked by General Molara to seduce Savrola.
Lucile finds herself attracted to Savrola, leading to confused loyalties.
Savrola escapes attempts to arrest him and flees with Lucile.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Savrola knows about the rebel army's intended invasion of Laurania.
The city is bombarded when Savrola is not produced.
